subject: maths
question:
The line chart given below shows the marks obtained by two students A and B in 6 subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af78745e71b9f1fdea1823c2fbc75df05feef68ccec5c3c5c9c7a9fe17bc2295.png] 

The marks obtained by A in all the subjects is what percent of the marks obtained by B in all the subjects?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Marks obtained by A in all subjects = 100 + 120 + 160 + 140 + 60 + 150 = 730

Marks obtained by B in all subjects = 70 + 180 + 170 + 110 + 130 + 80 = 740

Percentage of the marks obtained by A in all the subjects to the

marks obtained by B in all the subjects = 730/740 × 100 = 98.64 % 

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
